rounds.q: What % of the world's adults use tobacco?
rounds.why: In 2000 it was about 1 in 3 adults.
rounds.src: WHO, tobacco use trends report (2024 data)
rounds.fun: From about 1 in 3 adults in 2000 to 1 in 5 now. Tobacco is losing its grip!

rounds.q: What % of the world's adults had obesity in 2022?
rounds.why: In 1990 it was 7%, so it has more than doubled.
rounds.fun: From 7% in 1990 to 16% in 2022, more than doubled. Time for a dance break!

rounds.q: What % of people worldwide have safe drinking water at home?
rounds.why: From 2015 to 2024, 961 million people gained safe water at home.
rounds.fun: 961 million people got safe water at home from 2015 to 2024. Cheers to that!

rounds.q: By mid-2025, how many countries had been declared malaria-free?
rounds.why: Timor-Leste went from over 223,000 cases in 2006 to zero local cases by 2021.
rounds.fun: Timor-Leste went from over 223,000 cases to zero local cases. What a comeback!

rounds.q: Over the last 100 years, by what % have disaster death rates fallen?
rounds.why: Disasters now cause under 0.1% of deaths worldwide, thanks to forecasts and warnings.
rounds.src: Our World in Data, Natural Disasters
rounds.fun: Disaster death rates fell 90%. Forecasts and warnings are the real superheroes!
